description: Formal safety reference payloads. These are quantitative safety anchors for validation context and reporting, not kinetic benchmarks unless explicitly marked otherwise.

matrix_reference_ranges.comment: Reported by the SLR as in a similar industrial range to soy wet-extraction proteins, but the exact bounded range was not extracted into the repo.

what_it_supports: Upper-bound reference context for acrylamide in processed plant-protein ingredients
Safety-surface reporting for plant matrices
what_it_does_not_support: Dynamic kinetic fitting across T, t, and free asparagine
entries.comment: Use as a reporting and validation reference band, not as a replacement for Parker or Knol kinetics.

what_it_supports: Finished-product PBMA acrylamide reporting context
Protein and free-lysine correlation context for mitigation narratives
what_it_does_not_support: Direct transfer of endpoint values to aqueous benchmark slurries
entries.comment: Use as a finished-product safety band distinct from ingredient endpoints.

entries.source_citation: Choi et al. (2024), roasted garden peas

method.notes: MRM transitions and calibration stated in the source.

entries.comment: Use as mechanistically honest precursor-correlation provenance.

what_it_supports: Activation-energy provenance for predict_acrylamide
Field-standard free-system kinetic framing

entries.comment: Model provenance only; do not display as if it were an endpoint benchmark band.

method.notes: Commercial plant-based meat analog survey with isotopically labelled AGE standards

what_it_supports: Broad commercial validation band for CML and CEL in plant-based analogs
Cross-check that CEL remains above CML across high-temperature plant-protein products
what_it_does_not_support: Exact process reconstruction for a single formulation
Standalone kinetic fitting without a representative process proxy
entries.comment: Use alongside the Foods 2023 product cluster to keep broad AGE bands visible in runtime safety reporting.

method.notes: Amino-acid capping mitigation study reporting near-complete acrylamide suppression

matrix_reference_ranges.comment: Reported suppression of acrylamide by cysteine plus glycine relative to the uncontrolled reference

what_it_supports: Mitigation-side safety context for amino-acid capping strategies
Upper-bound suppression reference for acrylamide guardrail interpretation
what_it_does_not_support: Standalone kinetic fitting across arbitrary formulation conditions
Direct transfer to finished-product endpoint prediction without context
entries.comment: Use as an extended mitigation reference for safety interpretation, not as a substitute for temperature-time kinetics.

method.notes: Backlog summary reports a saponin dose-acrylamide relationship plus DSC shift and pyrazine skew

matrix_reference_ranges.comment: Dose-responsive acrylamide modulation with simultaneous pyrazine skew and approximately 6 C thermal shift

what_it_supports: Bounded process-modifier context linking saponin load to acrylamide interpretation
Safety and flavour trade-off framing where pyrazine skew accompanies the acrylamide response
what_it_does_not_support: Exact process reconstruction for SPI or PPI matrices
entries.comment: Use as an extended process-modifier reference when additive composition or foaming-active fractions are expected to move both acrylamide and pyrazine posture.

method.notes: Mild extrusion proxy summarized in Report 12: furosine peaks near 140 C and declines once degradation dominates above 150 C

matrix_reference_ranges.comment: Peak mild-extrusion furosine anchor before high-temperature degradation dominates

what_it_supports: Reference anchor for non-monotonic furosine behavior across extrusion temperature
Runtime reporting that a drop above 150 C reflects degradation into downstream damage markers, not reduced damage
what_it_does_not_support: Exact SPI/PPI process reconstruction without matrix-specific calibration
entries.comment: Use with CEL and CML context so severe-extrusion damage is not under-read when furosine declines.
